competitors.name: Web Design Miami Company
competitors.observation: Its Essential Site is advertised at $2,495 one time for three to five pages, a contact form, click-to-call, and Google Business Profile setup.
competitors.action: On the SBC package page, make page count, first-year inclusions, renewal terms, and the path to a custom quote easy to compare.

competitors.name: Made by Sebby
competitors.observation: The agency promotes English and Spanish websites, monthly website care, and local SEO with publicly listed prices.
competitors.action: Test a Spanish-language inquiry path for one service SBC can deliver in Spanish. Track qualified inquiries and paid orders from that path.

competitors.name: GoDaddy
competitors.observation: GoDaddy promotes a free website-building entry point and a domain with annual Website Builder plans.
competitors.action: Show prospects what SBC sets up for them and what support they can expect after launch.

competitors.name: Wix
competitors.observation: Wix offers a free building tier and lists payment acceptance and basic ecommerce on its Core plan.
competitors.action: Demonstrate a complete customer journey in the SBC store demo, from a product page through the merchant's payment setup.

competitors.name: HubSpot
competitors.observation: HubSpot offers a free CRM with contact management and a sales pipeline.
competitors.action: In the Office Box demo, use one industry-specific workflow to show what happens after an inquiry becomes a job.

competitors.name: VistaPrint
competitors.observation: VistaPrint lets buyers customize standard business cards with different sizes, paper options, and quantities.
competitors.action: Show the design brief, proof review, and expected handoff date together on the SBC card order page.
